lead: Ajay Devgn is an Indian film director, born on 2 April 1968 in New Delhi.
As of 2026, he is 58 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aries sign.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Padma Shri in arts and National Film Award for Best Actor.
This profile collects the Ajay facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
